breakdown.description: A bulk density larger than the theoretical density, which would imply negative porosity for a porous ceramic.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses a bulk density of 3.25 g/cm^3 (matching the ground truth), which is less than the theoretical density of 3.98 g/cm^3, yielding a physically meaningful positive porosity of 18.3%. The original erroneous value of 4.25 g/cm^3 (which would have implied negative porosity) was not used.
